description: This file is a Swift source file responsible for handling logging within the OpenClaw application. It sets up logging configurations, manages log levels, formats log messages, and directs logs to different handlers such as OS logs and file logs. It also provides utility functions for label parsing and log message generation.

classes.name: OpenClawOSLogHandler
classes.description: Handles logging to the system's OSLog, supporting different log levels and metadata merging.

classes.name: OpenClawFileLogHandler
classes.description: Handles logging to a file, supporting metadata annotation and conditional logging based on user settings.

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level from user defaults.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level in user defaults.

methods.name: fileLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if file logging is enabled in user defaults.

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Provides the default log level value.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the raw value of the log level, used as an identifier.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Provides a user-friendly display name for the log level.

methods.name: bootstrapIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes logging system bootstrap if it hasn't been done.

methods.name: makeLabel
methods.description: Creates a label string from subsystem and category identifiers.

methods.name: parseLabel
methods.description: Parses a label string into subsystem and category components.
